name: Emerald Queen Casino
note: Right-sleeve partner of Seattle Sounders FC since 2021 (through 2027, per MLSsoccer.com); the EQC logo features on the primary kit sleeve. Owned and operated by the Puyallup Tribe of Indians, a federally recognized tribal government; no human-rights record found against the tribe or the casino that would meet METHOD.md's test, so a tier is proposed as none (state ownership alone is not a tier).
